note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: SpinUp
clips.desc: start: rotor accelerates to lift speed, louvres open to 70 deg, outlet glow rises

clips.name: Lift
clips.desc: hovering: steady spin 3 blades / 12 f (seamless, 7-fold), louvres open, glow on

clips.name: Pulse
clips.desc: thrust pulse: louvres snap to 85 deg, pulse ring expands, glow flares, rotor at speed

clips.name: Cooldown
clips.desc: shutdown: rotor spins down, louvres close, glow fades (ends 4 blades on = rest-equivalent)

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
